# `prim.quad_sphere`: Quad sphere

Creates a sphere of even quads with no poles (a projected subdivided cube).

- Category: prim
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(segments^2)
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: uv sphere, add sphere, cube sphere, spherified cube, polySphere, ball

The default sphere: even quads, eight valence-3 vertices, no pinched poles, so it subdivides and deforms cleanly.

**Segments** count quads along each cube edge; the equator gets four times as many edges. When omitted they follow the asset class's target edge length.

**Use for** balls, heads (blockout), domes, knobs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string \| null` | `null` | Object name; a free name such as `sphere_1` is picked when omitted. |
| `origin` | `OriginParam` | `"bottom"` | Origin at the bottom (rests on the ground) or the center. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | `null` | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Origin position in the parent's space. |
| `radius` | `Length` | `0.25` | Sphere radius. |
| `segments` | `number \| null` | `null` | Quads along each edge of the underlying cube (the equator has 4x as many); derived from the circumference when omitted. |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"ball","radius":"11cm","segments":6}
```

Result: `created ball (o:1) sphere 0.22 x 0.22 x 0.22 m: 216 faces (432 tris; budget 6,000)`
